input_fields.name: visible_target
input_fields.description: One visible, semantically identified object and expected object type.

input_fields.name: click_position
input_fields.description: One pre-highlighted click location in the viewport.

result_fields.name: selection_state
result_fields.description: One selected object identity, observed type, and selection evidence.

procedure: Set/verify selection_filter and move to click_position until pre-highlight identifies visible_target.
Observe highlight/status-bar object type and return selection_state.
If pre-highlight is ambiguous, clear/stop rather than selecting by pixel proximity.
rejection_rules: Reject hidden/ambiguous target, wrong filter, unsupported click observation, or a click location over overlapping candidates.
Do not use Ctrl/Shift modifiers in this atom.
Do not treat a highlight without identity evidence as a successful selection.
